product: Metric view listings are generally available in Databricks Marketplace
tagline: Providers can publish governed business metrics in Databricks Marketplace by adding metric views.
what_it_does: Providers can publish governed business metrics in Databricks Marketplace by adding metric views. Only Databricks recipients can use shared metric views. A share is a securable object in Unity Catalog that represents a collection of data and AI assets you want to share with one or more recipients.
